# libretro API header

`libretro.h` is an unmodified copy of `include/libretro.h` from
https://github.com/libretro/libretro-common at commit
`2b96a82bd8479bb3547d271e1eefadc82dd2161e`.

SHA-256: `c928d8f176b4e4bc45ee2a41ef236d25cc19e9bc2abc2e2e4c32cf08d6423801`

Its MIT license and copyright notice are retained in the header. This vendored
file allows offline builds without floating network dependencies.
